verdict.rationale: Pipedream's REST API docs explicitly state it can be used to 'create workflows, manage event sources, handle subscriptions, and more,' which supports agent-driven programmatic workflow creation and management, but there is no detailed documentation or example of update/activate operations, and no independent or hands-on evidence confirming full lifecycle control via the API. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/examples for updating and activating workflows, and third-party or hands-on confirmation of programmatic workflow lifecycle management.
